safetyCars.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/october-1995/14/belgian-grand-prix-9/ ('the Safety Car appears on lap 29' ... 'The race proper resumes on lap 32'); https://lightsoutblog.com/every-safety-car-deployment-at-the-belgian-grand-prix ('deployed on Lap 29')
safetyCars.note: Called for worsening rain with many cars on slicks. Lap 29-31 per Motor Sport's lap-by-lap. A fan wiki (f1.fandom) says laps 28-33; a search summary of lightsoutblog said 'six laps' but the page as fetched gave only the start lap. Hill's stop-and-go (F1DB lap 33) followed it.
